text.text_excerpt: This place had a dark, cool atmosphere. It was great for a drink or two and to check out. The service was ok, it was obviously a locals bar so they catered to their regulars more quickly than others. Nice dive bat though!

So I typically only visit this bar during Carnival time. Its like a hidden gem less than a few yards off of Bourbon Street. Rarely is it busting at the seams with tourist even though it is soo close. Might be because its kinda sketchy looking. Maybe its the jukebox selection. Pretty much only metal. Maybe its because the bathrooms are hidden behind a bookcase and the new folks walk out in embarrassment? Either way it s my go to on Lundi Gras for a few quick drinks with friends. Great for people watching too. The bartenders, I have only seen two, are cool chicks. I look forward to chatting with either one. I know they aren't the easiest to talk too in the beginning but that is my talent. C...

Cheap locals off bourbon bar. This spot used to be part of the dungeon I believe. The coolest feature here other then not having to pay and arm and a respective leg for alcohol is the bathrooms. Go in, ask where the bathrooms are and thank me later.
